# Failure matrix (generated by scripts/failure_matrix.py)

Each row injects one fault into a fake device and runs the real `apply_remediation_plan`. 'Device' is what actually happened to the device; 'Result' is what the system recorded. The two must agree: ROLLED_BACK only when the device is back to its original configuration.

| Scenario | Injected fault | Result | Plan status | HTTP | Device after | Alert | Before WP6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Happy path | none | **SUCCESS** | APPLIED | 200 | remediated | - | SUCCESS |
| Verification fails, rollback works | post-change check forced to fail | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 200 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK (claimed, never verified) |
| Verification fails, rollback fails | post-change check fails and the restore command errors | **ROLLBACK_FAILED** | ROLLBACK_FAILED | 200 | LEFT CHANGED | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK + 'SUCCESSFULLY_RESTORED' (FALSE: device left changed) |
| Connection refused | SSH connect fails before anything is sent | **ABORTED** | FAILED | 502 | unchanged | REMEDIATION_FAILED | ROLLED_BACK + 'rollback triggered' (FALSE: nothing had changed) |
| Empty running-config | device returns an empty backup | **ABORTED** | FAILED | 500 | unchanged | REMEDIATION_FAILED | not handled |
| SSH drop mid-push, reconnect works | 2 of the commands applied, then the session died | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 500 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK (FALSE: dead session, device left half-changed) |
| SSH drop right after push | change fully applied, then the session died | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 500 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK (FALSE: device left changed) |
| Device dies mid-push | partial change and the device stays unreachable | **ROLLBACK_FAILED** | ROLLBACK_FAILED | 500 | LEFT CHANGED | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK (FALSE: device left half-changed) |
| Corrupt output after push | one corrupted 'show running-config' read | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 500 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK |
| Device ignores the change | pushes accepted but not applied | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 200 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK |
| Real IOS (no reset command) | 'simulator-reset-pristine' is an invalid command | **ROLLED_BACK** | FAILED | 200 | original config | CRITICAL_DRIFT | ROLLED_BACK (only the first 30 backup lines replayed, unverified) |

False 'ROLLED_BACK' claims after WP6: **0**.
